PluginData.Author: Zeo-Corps
PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.5 — Live weapon telemetry for War Room and faction replay. Tactical HUD, Quick Refill and distress GPS.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Core 1.0.5 adds observed WeaponCore firing and projectile telemetry to the shared War Room and faction recordings. Captures the controlled ship and mechanical subgrids while telemetry sharing is enabled. Includes independent HUD resizing, Quick Refill and its keybind, tactical markers, fleet sharing, hidden distress GPS, and overlay shutdown recovery. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
